en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi from Muhammad b. Salim from Ahmad b. al-Nadr from `Amr b. Shimr from Jabir from Abi Ja`far (as).
He said: For everything is a spring, and the spring of the Quran is the month of Ramadan.
